# Design: plugin-coingecko-scanner + skill market-analysis

**Date**: 2026-03-27
**Approach**: MVP First — 1 plugin + 1 skill, đủ để học pattern và chạy được
**Target**: Team BD tại Lab3

---

## Part 1: Plugin `plugin-coingecko-scanner`

### Tổng quan

Plugin scan data crypto từ CoinGecko Free API, lưu vào plugin state, emit events cho các plugin khác (telegram-notifier), và tự tạo issue khi phát hiện biến động lớn.

### Cấu trúc file

```
packages/plugins/examples/plugin-coingecko-scanner/
├── package.json
├── src/
│   ├── manifest.ts           ← Capabilities, job, settings page
│   ├── worker.ts             ← 1 job "scan-coingecko", logic xử lý
│   └── ui/
│       └── settings-page.tsx ← Config: coin list, interval, thresholds
├── tsconfig.json
└── vite.config.ts
```

### Manifest

```typescript
{
  id: "lab3-ai.plugin-coingecko-scanner",
  apiVersion: 1,
  version: "0.1.0",
  displayName: "CoinGecko Scanner",
  description: "Scan crypto market data from CoinGecko — prices, trends, volume alerts",
  author: "lab3-ai",
  categories: ["connector", "automation"],
  capabilities: [
    "http.outbound",
    "jobs.schedule",
    "plugin.state.read",
    "plugin.state.write",
    "events.emit",
    "issues.create",
    "activity.log.write",
    "instance.settings.register",
  ],
  instanceConfigSchema: {
    type: "object",
    properties: {
      companyId:              { type: "string", title: "Company ID" },
      scanMode:               { type: "string", title: "Scan Mode", enum: ["top", "trending", "watchlist", "all"], default: "top" },
      watchlistCoinIds:       { type: "string", title: "Watchlist Coin IDs (comma-separated)", default: "bitcoin,ethereum,solana" },
      topCoinsLimit:          { type: "number", title: "Top Coins Limit", default: 20 },
      priceChangeThreshold:   { type: "number", title: "Price Change Alert Threshold (%)", default: 10 },
      volumeChangeThreshold:  { type: "number", title: "Volume Change Alert Threshold (%)", default: 50 },
      currency:               { type: "string", title: "Currency", default: "usd" },
    },
    required: ["companyId"],
  },
  entrypoints: {
    worker: "./dist/worker.js",
    ui: "./dist/ui",
  },
  jobs: [{
    jobKey: "scan-coingecko",
    displayName: "Scan CoinGecko Markets",
    description: "Fetch crypto market data and detect price/volume anomalies",
    schedule: "*/5 * * * *",
  }],
  ui: {
    slots: [{
      type: "settingsPage",
      id: "coingecko-scanner-settings",
      displayName: "CoinGecko Scanner Settings",
      exportName: "CoingeckoScannerSettings",
    }],
  },
}
```

### Settings Page

| Setting | Type | Default | Mô tả |
|---------|------|---------|--------|
| `companyId` | string | — (required) | Company ID để tạo issues |
| `scanMode` | enum | `"top"` | `"top"` / `"trending"` / `"watchlist"` / `"all"` |
| `watchlistCoinIds` | string | `"bitcoin,ethereum,solana"` | Comma-separated CoinGecko coin IDs |
| `topCoinsLimit` | number | `20` | Số coins top market cap |
| `priceChangeThreshold` | number | `10` | % thay đổi giá để trigger alert/issue |
| `volumeChangeThreshold` | number | `50` | % volume spike để trigger |
| `currency` | string | `"usd"` | Đơn vị tiền tệ |

### CoinGecko API Endpoints (Free tier, no API key needed)

| Endpoint | Dùng cho | Khi nào gọi |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `GET /api/v3/coins/markets?vs_currency=usd&order=market_cap_desc&per_page={limit}` | Top coins: giá, volume, market cap, % change | scanMode = `"top"` hoặc `"all"` |
| `GET /api/v3/search/trending` | Trending coins đang hot | scanMode = `"trending"` hoặc `"all"` |
| `GET /api/v3/simple/price?ids={coinIds}&vs_currencies={currency}&include_24hr_change=true&include_24hr_vol=true` | Watchlist cụ thể | scanMode = `"watchlist"` hoặc `"all"` |

**Rate limit**: Free tier cho phép 10-30 calls/phút. Với scan mỗi 5 phút, mỗi lần gọi tối đa 3 endpoints (mode `"all"`), nằm trong giới hạn an toàn.

### Data Flow

```
┌──────────────┐     ┌───────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐
│ CoinGecko    │     │ Plugin State  │     │ Events           │
│ Free API     │────▶│ (lưu kết quả │────▶│ "coingecko-scan- │
│              │     │  scan + diff  │     │  complete"        │
│ /coins/      │     │  với lần      │     │                  │
│  markets     │     │  trước)       │     │ "coingecko-      │
│ /search/     │     │               │     │  price-alert"    │
│  trending    │     └───────────────┘     └────────┬─────────┘
└──────────────┘                                    │
                                                    ▼
                                           ┌──────────────────┐
                                           │ Nếu threshold    │
                                           │ vượt ngưỡng:     │
                                           │ • Tạo Issue      │
                                           │ • Emit alert     │
                                           │   event          │
                                           └──────────────────┘
```

### Worker Logic

```
Job "scan-coingecko" chạy mỗi lần:

1. Đọc config (companyId, scanMode, thresholds, coin list)
2. Gọi CoinGecko API theo scanMode:
   - "top"       → GET /coins/markets
   - "trending"  → GET /search/trending
   - "watchlist" → GET /simple/price
   - "all"       → gọi cả 3
3. Đọc state cũ: ctx.state.get({ scopeKind: "instance", stateKey: "last-scan" })
4. So sánh với lần scan trước:
   - Tính % thay đổi giá mỗi coin
   - Tính % thay đổi volume mỗi coin
5. Lưu state mới: ctx.state.set({ scopeKind: "instance", stateKey: "last-scan" }, newData)
6. Emit event "coingecko-scan-complete" (luôn luôn, chứa toàn bộ data)
7. Check thresholds cho từng coin:
   - Nếu |priceChange| > priceChangeThreshold HOẶC |volumeChange| > volumeChangeThreshold:
     → Emit "coingecko-price-alert" (chứa coin + lý do)
     → Tạo issue trong company:
       Title: "🔔 {COIN} {+/-X%} trong 24h"
       Description: Chi tiết price, volume, so sánh
       Priority: "high" nếu >20%, "medium" nếu >10%
8. Ghi activity log: "Scanned {N} coins, {M} alerts triggered"
```

### Plugin State Schema

```typescript
// stateKey: "last-scan"
{
  scannedAt: string;          // ISO timestamp
  scanMode: string;
  coins: Array<{
    id: string;               // "bitcoin"
    symbol: string;           // "btc"
    name: string;             // "Bitcoin"
    currentPrice: number;
    priceChange24h: number;   // % change
    volume24h: number;
    volumeChange24h: number;  // % change (so với lần scan trước)
    marketCap: number;
    source: "top" | "trending" | "watchlist";
  }>;
  alertsTriggered: number;
}
```

### Events Emitted

| Event | Khi nào | Payload |
|-------|--------|---------|
| `coingecko-scan-complete` | Mỗi lần scan xong | `{ scannedAt, coinCount, coins: [...] }` |
| `coingecko-price-alert` | Coin vượt threshold | `{ coin, priceChange, volumeChange, reason }` |

### Error Handling

| Lỗi | Xử lý |
|------|--------|
| CoinGecko 429 (rate limit) | Log warning, skip lần này, chờ lần sau |
| API timeout / network error | Log error, không crash worker |
| Config thiếu companyId | Skip tạo issue, vẫn scan và lưu state + emit events |
| Lần scan đầu (không có state cũ) | Lưu data, không so sánh, không trigger alerts |

    82→```
    83→
    84→### Settings Page
    85→
    86→| Setting | Type | Default | Mô tả |
    87→|---------|------|---------|--------|
    88→| `companyId` | string | — (required) | Company ID để tạo issues |
    89→| `scanMode` | enum | `"top"` | `"top"` / `"trending"` / `"watchlist"` / `"all"` |
    90→| `watchlistCoinIds` | string | `"bitcoin,ethereum,solana"` | Comma-separated CoinGecko coin IDs |
    91→| `topCoinsLimit` | number | `20` | Số coins top market cap |
    92→| `priceChangeThreshold` | number | `10` | % thay đổi giá để trigger alert/issue |
    93→| `volumeChangeThreshold` | number | `50` | % volume spike để trigger |
    94→| `currency` | string | `"usd"` | Đơn vị tiền tệ |
    95→
    96→### CoinGecko API Endpoints (Free tier, no API key needed)
    97→
    98→| Endpoint | Dùng cho | Khi nào gọi |
    99→|----------|---------|-------------|
   100→| `GET /api/v3/coins/markets?vs_currency=usd&order=market_cap_desc&per_page={limit}` | Top coins: giá, volume, market cap, % change | scanMode = `"top"` hoặc `"all"` |
   101→| `GET /api/v3/search/trending` | Trending coins đang hot | scanMode = `"trending"` hoặc `"all"` |
   102→| `GET /api/v3/simple/price?ids={coinIds}&vs_currencies={currency}&include_24hr_change=true&include_24hr_vol=true` | Watchlist cụ thể | scanMode = `"watchlist"` hoặc `"all"` |
   103→
   104→**Rate limit**: Free tier cho phép 10-30 calls/phút. Với scan mỗi 5 phút, mỗi lần gọi tối đa 3 endpoints (mode `"all"`), nằm trong giới hạn an toàn.
   105→
   106→### Data Flow
   107→
   108→```
   109→┌──────────────┐     ┌───────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐
   110→│ CoinGecko    │     │ Plugin State  │     │ Events           │
   111→│ Free API     │────▶│ (lưu kết quả │────▶│ "coingecko-scan- │
   112→│              │     │  scan + diff  │     │  complete"        │
   113→│ /coins/      │     │  với lần      │     │                  │
   114→│  markets     │     │  trước)       │     │ "coingecko-      │
   115→│ /search/     │     │               │     │  price-alert"    │
   116→│  trending    │     └───────────────┘     └────────┬─────────┘
   117→└──────────────┘                                    │
   118→                                                    ▼
   119→                                           ┌──────────────────┐
   120→                                           │ Nếu threshold    │
   121→                                           │ vượt ngưỡng:     │
   122→                                           │ • Tạo Issue      │
   123→                                           │ • Emit alert     │
   124→                                           │   event          │
   125→                                           └──────────────────┘
   126→```
   127→
   128→### Worker Logic
   129→
   130→```
   131→Job "scan-coingecko" chạy mỗi lần:
   132→
   133→1. Đọc config (companyId, scanMode, thresholds, coin list)
   134→2. Gọi CoinGecko API theo scanMode:
   135→   - "top"       → GET /coins/markets
   136→   - "trending"  → GET /search/trending
   137→   - "watchlist" → GET /simple/price
   138→   - "all"       → gọi cả 3
   139→3. Đọc state cũ: ctx.state.get({ scopeKind: "instance", stateKey: "last-scan" })
   140→4. So sánh với lần scan trước:
   141→   - Tính % thay đổi giá mỗi coin
   142→   - Tính % thay đổi volume mỗi coin
   143→5. Lưu state mới: ctx.state.set({ scopeKind: "instance", stateKey: "last-scan" }, newData)
   144→6. Emit event "coingecko-scan-complete" (luôn luôn, chứa toàn bộ data)
   145→7. Check thresholds cho từng coin:
   146→   - Nếu |priceChange| > priceChangeThreshold HOẶC |volumeChange| > volumeChangeThreshold:
   147→     → Emit "coingecko-price-alert" (chứa coin + lý do)
   148→     → Tạo issue trong company:
   149→       Title: "🔔 {COIN} {+/-X%} trong 24h"
   150→       Description: Chi tiết price, volume, so sánh
   151→       Priority: "high" nếu >20%, "medium" nếu >10%
   152→8. Ghi activity log: "Scanned {N} coins, {M} alerts triggered"
   153→```
   154→
   155→### Plugin State Schema
   156→
   157→```typescript
   158→// stateKey: "last-scan"
   159→{
   160→  scannedAt: string;          // ISO timestamp
   161→  scanMode: string;
   162→  coins: Array<{
   163→    id: string;               // "bitcoin"
   164→    symbol: string;           // "btc"
   165→    name: string;             // "Bitcoin"
   166→    currentPrice: number;
   167→    priceChange24h: number;   // % change
   168→    volume24h: number;
   169→    volumeChange24h: number;  // % change (so với lần scan trước)
   170→    marketCap: number;
   171→    source: "top" | "trending" | "watchlist";
   172→  }>;
   173→  alertsTriggered: number;
   174→}
   175→```
   176→
   177→### Events Emitted
   178→
   179→| Event | Khi nào | Payload |
   180→|-------|--------|---------|
   181→| `coingecko-scan-complete` | Mỗi lần scan xong | `{ scannedAt, coinCount, coins: [...] }` |
   182→| `coingecko-price-alert` | Coin vượt threshold | `{ coin, priceChange, volumeChange, reason }` |
   183→
   184→### Error Handling
   185→
   186→| Lỗi | Xử lý |
   187→|------|--------|
   188→| CoinGecko 429 (rate limit) | Log warning, skip lần này, chờ lần sau |
   189→| API timeout / network error | Log error, không crash worker |
   190→| Config thiếu companyId | Skip tạo issue + skip emit events (cả 2 cần companyId), vẫn scan và lưu state |
   191→| Lần scan đầu (không có state cũ) | Lưu data, không so sánh, không trigger alerts |
   192→

   194→
   195→## Part 2: Skill `market-analysis`
   196→
   197→### Tổng quan
   198→
   199→Skill markdown (~50 dòng) dạy agent (Market Analyst) cách phân tích crypto market data bằng price action đơn giản. Agent đọc skill này lúc startup và follow quy trình khi checkout task phân tích.
   200→
   201→### Cấu trúc file
   202→
   203→```
   204→skills/market-analysis/
   205→└── SKILL.md
   206→```
   207→
   208→### Nội dung SKILL.md
   209→
   210→**Frontmatter:**
   211→```yaml
   212→name: market-analysis
   213→description: Hướng dẫn agent phân tích thị trường crypto bằng price action — so sánh % thay đổi giá, volume, trend tuần
   214→```
   215→
   216→**Các phần chính:**
   217→
   218→#### 1. Khi nào dùng skill này
   219→- Khi checkout task liên quan phân tích market/crypto
   220→- Khi đọc data từ coingecko-scanner hoặc polymarket-scanner
   221→
   222→#### 2. Quy trình phân tích (5 bước)
   223→
   224→```
   225→Bước 1: Thu thập data
   226→  → Đọc task comments/documents chứa scan results
   227→  → Đọc memory (para-memory) để lấy data tuần trước nếu có
   228→
   229→Bước 2: So sánh % thay đổi
   230→  → Giá 24h: tăng/giảm bao nhiêu %?
   231→  → Volume 24h: spike hay giảm so với trung bình?
   232→  → So với tuần trước: trend đi lên hay xuống?
   233→
   234→Bước 3: Xác định tín hiệu
   235→  → 🟢 Bullish: giá tăng >5% + volume tăng >20%
   236→  → 🔴 Bearish: giá giảm >5% + volume tăng (panic sell)
   237→  → 🟡 Neutral: biến động <5%, volume bình thường
   238→
   239→Bước 4: Tổng hợp
   240→  → Xếp hạng coins theo mức độ đáng chú ý
   241→  → Highlight top 3 movers
   242→
   243→Bước 5: Output
   244→  → Comment lên task theo template bên dưới
   245→  → Nếu có signal 🟢 hoặc 🔴 mạnh → tạo subtask cho Content Writer
   246→  → Lưu vào para-memory để tuần sau so sánh
   247→```
   248→
   249→#### 3. Tiêu chí đánh giá
   250→
   251→| Signal | Điều kiện | Hành động |
   252→|--------|----------|-----------|
   253→| 🟢 Bullish mạnh | Giá +>10%, volume +>30% | Tạo subtask viết bài |
   254→| 🟢 Bullish nhẹ | Giá +5-10% | Ghi nhận, theo dõi |
   255→| 🟡 Neutral | Biến động <5% | Ghi nhận |
   256→| 🔴 Bearish nhẹ | Giá -5-10% | Ghi nhận, theo dõi |
   257→| 🔴 Bearish mạnh | Giá ->10%, volume +>30% | Tạo subtask viết bài cảnh báo |
   258→
   259→#### 4. Template Output
   260→
   261→```markdown
   262→## Market Analysis - [Ngày]
   263→
   264→### Top Movers (24h)
   265→| Coin | Giá | 24h % | Volume % | Signal |
   266→|------|-----|-------|----------|--------|
   267→| ...  | ... | ...   | ...      | 🟢/🔴/🟡 |
   268→
   269→### Tín hiệu đáng chú ý
   270→- [Coin]: [Lý do] — [Hành động đề xuất]
   271→
   272→### So với tuần trước
   273→- Trend chung: [Bullish/Bearish/Sideways]
   274→- Điểm khác biệt: [...]
   275→
   276→### Đề xuất
   277→- [ ] Viết bài về [topic] (nếu có signal mạnh)
   278→```
   279→
   280→### Mối liên hệ Plugin ↔ Skill
   281→
   282→```
   283→Plugin coingecko-scanner          Skill market-analysis
   284→┌─────────────────────┐          ┌─────────────────────┐
   285→│ Scan data tự động   │          │ Dạy agent cách      │
   286→│ Lưu vào state       │────▶     │ đọc data từ plugin  │
   287→│ Emit events         │          │ So sánh % change     │
   288→│ Tạo issue nếu alert │          │ Phân loại tín hiệu  │
   289→│                     │          │ Output theo template │
   290→└─────────────────────┘          └─────────────────────┘
   291→     (code tự chạy)                 (kiến thức cho AI)
   292→```
   293→
   294→Plugin cung cấp **data thô + alerts tự động**. Skill dạy agent **cách phân tích sâu hơn và viết báo cáo** khi được giao task.
   295→

   297→
   298→## Testing
   299→
   300→### Plugin test
   301→1. Install plugin vào Paperclip: UI → Plugin Manager → Install
   302→2. Cấu hình settings: companyId, scanMode = "top", thresholds
   303→3. Trigger job thủ công hoặc đợi cron
   304→4. Verify: plugin state có data, events được emit, issues tạo khi threshold vượt
   305→
   306→### Skill test
   307→1. Import skill vào company: `POST /api/companies/:companyId/skills/import`
   308→2. Assign skill cho Market Analyst agent
   309→3. Tạo task "Phân tích thị trường hôm nay" assign cho agent
   310→4. Verify: agent output theo đúng template, có tín hiệu đúng format
   311→

# Writing Plans

## Overview

Write comprehensive implementation plans assuming the engineer has zero context for our codebase and questionable taste. Document everything they need to know: which files to touch for each task, code, testing, docs they might need to check, how to test it. Give them the whole plan as bite-sized tasks. DRY. YAGNI. TDD. Frequent commits.

Assume they are a skilled developer, but know almost nothing about our toolset or problem domain. Assume they don't know good test design very well.

**Announce at start:** "I'm using the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan."

**Context:** This should be run in a dedicated worktree (created by brainstorming skill).

**Save plans to:** `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature-name>.md`
- (User preferences for plan location override this default)

## Scope Check

If the spec covers multiple independent subsystems, it should have been broken into sub-project specs during brainstorming. If it wasn't, suggest breaking this into separate plans — one per subsystem. Each plan should produce working, testable software on its own.

## File Structure

Before defining tasks, map out which files will be created or modified and what each one is responsible for. This is where decomposition decisions get locked in.

- Design units with clear boundaries and well-defined interfaces. Each file should have one clear responsibility.
- You reason best about code you can hold in context at once, and your edits are more reliable when files are focused. Prefer smaller, focused files over large ones that do too much.
- Files that change together should live together. Split by responsibility, not by technical layer.
- In existing codebases, follow established patterns. If the codebase uses large files, don't unilaterally restructure - but if a file you're modifying has grown unwieldy, including a split in the plan is reasonable.

This structure informs the task decomposition. Each task should produce self-contained changes that make sense independently.

## Bite-Sized Task Granularity

**Each step is one action (2-5 minutes):**
- "Write the failing test" - step
- "Run it to make sure it fails" - step
- "Implement the minimal code to make the test pass" - step
- "Run the tests and make sure they pass" - step
- "Commit" - step

## Plan Document Header

**Every plan MUST start with this header:**

```markdown
# [Feature Name] Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** [One sentence describing what this builds]

**Architecture:** [2-3 sentences about approach]

**Tech Stack:** [Key technologies/libraries]

---
```

## Task Structure

````markdown
### Task N: [Component Name]

**Files:**
- Create: `exact/path/to/file.py`
- Modify: `exact/path/to/existing.py:123-145`
- Test: `tests/exact/path/to/test.py`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```python
def test_specific_behavior():
    result = function(input)
    assert result == expected
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run test to verify it fails**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: FAIL with "function not defined"

- [ ] **Step 3: Write minimal implementation**

```python
def function(input):
    return expected
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run test to verify it passes**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: PASS

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git add tests/path/test.py src/path/file.py
git commit -m "feat: add specific feature"
```
````

## Remember
- Exact file paths always
- Complete code in plan (not "add validation")
- Exact commands with expected output
- Reference relevant skills with @ syntax
- DRY, YAGNI, TDD, frequent commits

## Plan Review Loop

After writing the complete plan:

1. Dispatch a single plan-document-reviewer subagent (see plan-document-reviewer-prompt.md) with precisely crafted review context — never your session history. This keeps the reviewer focused on the plan, not your thought process.
   - Provide: path to the plan document, path to spec document
2. If ❌ Issues Found: fix the issues, re-dispatch reviewer for the whole plan
3. If ✅ Approved: proceed to execution handoff

**Review loop guidance:**
- Same agent that wrote the plan fixes it (preserves context)
- If loop exceeds 3 iterations, surface to human for guidance
- Reviewers are advisory — explain disagreements if you believe feedback is incorrect

## Execution Handoff

After saving the plan, offer execution choice:

**"Plan complete and saved to `docs/superpowers/plans/<filename>.md`. Two execution options:**

**1. Subagent-Driven (recommended)** - I dispatch a fresh subagent per task, review between tasks, fast iteration

**2. Inline Execution** - Execute tasks in this session using executing-plans, batch execution with checkpoints

**Which approach?"**

**If Subagent-Driven chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development
- Fresh subagent per task + two-stage review

**If Inline Execution chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:executing-plans
- Batch execution with checkpoints for review

## Summary Report

Based on my thorough exploration of the Paperclip plugin architecture, here are the exact file contents and key findings:

### 1. **Plugin Export Pattern**

**`packages/plugins/examples/plugin-hello-world-example/src/index.ts`:**
```
export { default as manifest } from "./manifest.js";
export { default as worker } from "./worker.js";
```

**`packages/plugins/examples/plugin-polymarket-scanner/src/index.ts`:**
```
export { default as manifest } from "./manifest.js";
```
(Only exports manifest, no worker export)

### 2. **Workspace Configuration**

**`pnpm-workspace.yaml`:**
Registers all plugins via:
```yaml
packages:
  - packages/*
  - packages/adapters/*
  - packages/plugins/*
  - packages/plugins/examples/*
```

### 3. **Plugin Package Contract**

Both example plugins use identical `paperclipPlugin` metadata in their `package.json`:
```json
"paperclipPlugin": {
  "manifest": "./dist/manifest.js",
  "worker": "./dist/worker.js",
  "ui": "./dist/ui/"
}
```

The plugin loader reads these paths at: `/Users/vuongluu/Documents/jobs/lab3/paperclip/paperclip/server/src/services/plugin-loader.ts`

### 4. **Plugin Manifest Types**

**`packages/plugins/examples/plugin-polymarket-scanner/src/types.ts`:**
Defines TypeScript interfaces for:
- `PolymarketConfig` — Instance configuration schema
- `Market` — Polymarket data structure
- `AnalyzedMarket` — Enriched market with AI analysis
- `GammaMarket` — Gamma API response shape
- `MarketEventPayload` — Event notification structure

### 5. **Plugin Discovery Mechanism**

The plugin loader at `server/src/services/plugin-loader.ts` discovers plugins via three sources:

**a) Local Filesystem Discovery (`discoverFromLocalFilesystem`):**
- Scans `~/.paperclip/plugins/` directory
- Handles both flat (`plugin-name/`) and scoped (`@scope/plugin-name/`) layouts
- Reads `package.json` and validates manifest

**b) npm Discovery (`discoverFromNpm`):**
- Searches `node_modules` directories for packages matching `paperclip-plugin-*` naming convention
- Default search paths: `cwd/node_modules` and `~/.paperclip/plugins/node_modules`
- Uses `NPM_PLUGIN_PACKAGE_PREFIX = "paperclip-plugin-"`

**c) Runtime Activation (`activatePlugin`):**
- Spawns worker process with tsx loader for first-party example plugins
- Registers event subscriptions, jobs, tools, and UI slots
- Syncs job declarations to database

### 6. **Bundled Example Plugins List**

**`server/src/routes/plugins.ts`** lines 117–166 define `BUNDLED_PLUGIN_EXAMPLES`:
1. `@paperclipai/plugin-hello-world-example` → `packages/plugins/examples/plugin-hello-world-example`
2. `@paperclipai/plugin-file-browser-example` → `packages/plugins/examples/plugin-file-browser-example`
3. `@paperclipai/plugin-kitchen-sink-example` → `packages/plugins/examples/plugin-kitchen-sink-example`
4. `@lab3-ai/plugin-x-scanner` → `packages/plugins/examples/plugin-x-scanner`
5. `@lab3-ai/plugin-polymarket-scanner` → `packages/plugins/examples/plugin-polymarket-scanner`
6. `@lab3-ai/plugin-telegram-notifier` → `packages/plugins/examples/plugin-telegram-notifier`

These are served at `GET /api/plugins/examples` endpoint (line 423).

### 7. **Server Initialization**

**`server/src/app.ts` (line 303):**
```javascript
void loader.loadAll().then((result) => {
  // Activates all plugins with "ready" status
});
```

The `loadAll()` method (line 1455 in plugin-loader.ts) fetches plugins from the registry in `"ready"` status and spawns their worker processes in parallel.

### Key Architectural Points:
- **Build Output:** `tsc` compiles TypeScript → `dist/manifest.js`, `dist/worker.js`, and `dist/ui/`
- **Worker Model:** Each plugin runs as an isolated Node.js worker process
- **RPC Bridge:** Plugins communicate with the host via `@paperclipai/plugin-sdk` (see `runWorker()` and `definePlugin()`)
- **Manifest-Driven:** All plugin capabilities, jobs, UI slots, and webhooks declared in manifest
- **Async Activation:** Plugins are loaded asynchronously at startup; failures don't block server initialization

   121→                                           │ vượt ngưỡng:     │
   122→                                           │ • Tạo Issue      │
   123→                                           │ • Emit alert     │
   124→                                           │   event          │
   125→                                           └──────────────────┘
   126→```
   127→
   128→### Worker Logic
   129→
   130→```
   131→Job "scan-coingecko" chạy mỗi lần:
   132→
   133→1. Đọc config (companyId, scanMode, thresholds, coin list)
   134→2. Gọi CoinGecko API theo scanMode:
   135→   - "top"       → GET /coins/markets
   136→   - "trending"  → GET /search/trending
   137→   - "watchlist" → GET /simple/price
   138→   - "all"       → gọi cả 3
   139→3. Đọc state cũ: ctx.state.get({ scopeKind: "instance", stateKey: "last-scan" })
   140→4. So sánh với lần scan trước:
   141→   - Tính % thay đổi giá mỗi coin
   142→   - Tính % thay đổi volume mỗi coin
   143→5. Lưu state mới: ctx.state.set({ scopeKind: "instance", stateKey: "last-scan" }, newData)
   144→6. Emit event "coingecko-scan-complete" (luôn luôn, chứa toàn bộ data)
   145→7. Check thresholds cho từng coin:
   146→   - Nếu |priceChange| > priceChangeThreshold HOẶC |volumeChange| > volumeChangeThreshold:
   147→     → Emit "coingecko-price-alert" (chứa coin + lý do)
   148→     → Tạo issue trong company:
   149→       Title: "🔔 {COIN} {+/-X%} trong 24h"
   150→       Description: Chi tiết price, volume, so sánh
   151→       Priority: "high" nếu >20%, "medium" nếu >10%
   152→8. Ghi activity log: "Scanned {N} coins, {M} alerts triggered"
   153→```
   154→
   155→### Plugin State Schema
   156→
   157→```typescript
   158→// stateKey: "last-scan"
   159→{
   160→  scannedAt: string;          // ISO timestamp
   161→  scanMode: string;
   162→  coins: Array<{
   163→    id: string;               // "bitcoin"
   164→    symbol: string;           // "btc"
   165→    name: string;             // "Bitcoin"
   166→    currentPrice: number;
   167→    priceChange24h: number;   // % change
   168→    volume24h: number;
   169→    volumeChange24h: number;  // % change (so với lần scan trước)
   170→    marketCap: number;
   171→    source: "top" | "trending" | "watchlist";
   172→  }>;
   173→  alertsTriggered: number;
   174→}
   175→```
   176→
   177→### Events Emitted
   178→
   179→| Event | Khi nào | Payload |
   180→|-------|--------|---------|
   181→| `coingecko-scan-complete` | Mỗi lần scan xong | `{ scannedAt, coinCount, coins: [...] }` |
   182→| `coingecko-price-alert` | Coin vượt threshold | `{ coin, priceChange, volumeChange, reason }` |
   183→
   184→### Error Handling
   185→
   186→| Lỗi | Xử lý |
   187→|------|--------|
   188→| CoinGecko 429 (rate limit) | Log warning, skip lần này, chờ lần sau |
   189→| API timeout / network error | Log error, không crash worker |
   190→| Config thiếu companyId | Skip tạo issue + skip emit events (cả 2 cần companyId), vẫn scan và lưu state |
   191→| Lần scan đầu (không có state cũ) | Lưu data, không so sánh, không trigger alerts |
   192→
   193→---
   194→
   195→## Part 2: Skill `market-analysis`
   196→
   197→### Tổng quan
   198→
   199→Skill markdown (~50 dòng) dạy agent (Market Analyst) cách phân tích crypto market data bằng price action đơn giản. Agent đọc skill này lúc startup và follow quy trình khi checkout task phân tích.
   200→
   201→### Cấu trúc file
   202→
   203→```
   204→skills/market-analysis/
   205→└── SKILL.md
   206→```
   207→
   208→### Nội dung SKILL.md
   209→

   211→```yaml
   212→name: market-analysis
   213→description: Hướng dẫn agent phân tích thị trường crypto bằng price action — so sánh % thay đổi giá, volume, trend tuần
   214→```
   215→
   216→**Các phần chính:**
   217→

   219→- Khi checkout task liên quan phân tích market/crypto
   220→- Khi đọc data từ coingecko-scanner hoặc polymarket-scanner
   221→
   222→#### 2. Quy trình phân tích (5 bước)
   223→
   224→```
   225→Bước 1: Thu thập data
   226→  → Đọc task comments/documents chứa scan results
   227→  → Đọc memory (para-memory) để lấy data tuần trước nếu có
   228→
   229→Bước 2: So sánh % thay đổi
   230→  → Giá 24h: tăng/giảm bao nhiêu %?
   231→  → Volume 24h: spike hay giảm so với trung bình?
   232→  → So với tuần trước: trend đi lên hay xuống?
   233→
   234→Bước 3: Xác định tín hiệu
   235→  → 🟢 Bullish: giá tăng >5% + volume tăng >20%
   236→  → 🔴 Bearish: giá giảm >5% + volume tăng (panic sell)
   237→  → 🟡 Neutral: biến động <5%, volume bình thường
   238→
   239→Bước 4: Tổng hợp

   241→  → Highlight top 3 movers
   242→
   243→Bước 5: Output
   244→  → Comment lên task theo template bên dưới
   245→  → Nếu có signal 🟢 hoặc 🔴 mạnh → tạo subtask cho Content Writer

   251→| Signal | Điều kiện | Hành động |
   252→|--------|----------|-----------|
   253→| 🟢 Bullish mạnh | Giá +>10%, volume +>30% | Tạo subtask viết bài |
   254→| 🟢 Bullish nhẹ | Giá +5-10% | Ghi nhận, theo dõi |
   255→| 🟡 Neutral | Biến động <5% | Ghi nhận |
   256→| 🔴 Bearish nhẹ | Giá -5-10% | Ghi nhận, theo dõi |

   268→
   269→### Tín hiệu đáng chú ý
   270→- [Coin]: [Lý do] — [Hành động đề xuất]
   271→
   272→### So với tuần trước

## Review Report: CoinGecko Scanner Plugin + Market Analysis Skill

### Verdict: **ISSUES FOUND**

There are several issues that need attention, though the plan is largely well-structured and closely follows the polymarket-scanner pattern. Below are findings categorized by severity.

---

### What Was Done Well

- The plan faithfully follows the polymarket-scanner pattern for plugin structure: `definePlugin` + `runWorker`, concurrency guard, state management, event emission, activity logging, data provider, health check, and config validation.
- Task ordering is correct -- scaffold first, then types, API client, manifest, worker, UI, server registration, skill, and finally end-to-end verification. Each task builds on the previous one logically.
- The CoinGecko API client is cleanly separated and uses the SDK's `ctx.http.fetch` binding pattern correctly.
- The skill file follows the existing SKILL.md frontmatter format from `/Users/vuongluu/Documents/jobs/lab3/paperclip/paperclip/skills/paperclip/SKILL.md`.
- The BUNDLED_PLUGIN_EXAMPLES entry format matches the existing entries exactly.

---

### Critical Issues (Must Fix)

**1. SDK dependency version mismatch in package.json**

The plan uses `"workspace:*"` for the plugin-sdk dependency:
```json
"@paperclipai/plugin-sdk": "workspace:*"
```

However, the three Lab3-authored plugins (polymarket-scanner, x-scanner, telegram-notifier) all use a published version:
```json
"@paperclipai/plugin-sdk": "^2026.325.0"
```

Only the Paperclip-authored example plugins (hello-world, kitchen-sink, file-browser) use `"workspace:*"`. Since this plugin uses the `@lab3-ai/` namespace and `"private": false`, it should use the published version `"^2026.325.0"` for consistency with the other Lab3 plugins and to ensure it works when published.

**File:** Plan Task 1, Step 1 (`package.json` line 77)

---

### Important Issues (Should Fix)

**2. Spec mentions `vite.config.ts` but plan omits it**

The spec's file structure at lines 17-27 lists `vite.config.ts` as part of the plugin. The plan omits it entirely. However, the polymarket-scanner reference plugin also has no `vite.config.ts` and uses `tsc` for builds. This deviation from the spec is actually *correct* -- the plan follows the real working pattern. ## Part 1: Plugin `plugin-coingecko-scanner`

### Tổng quan

Plugin scan data crypto từ CoinGecko Free API, lưu vào plugin state, emit events cho các plugin khác (telegram-notifier), và tự tạo issue khi phát hiện biến động lớn.

```

### Manifest

```typescript
{
  id: "lab3-ai.plugin-coingecko-scanner",

### Settings Page

| Setting | Type | Default | Mô tả |
|---------|------|---------|--------|
| `companyId` | string | — (required) | Company ID để tạo issues |
| `scanMode` | enum | `"top"` | `"top"` / `"trending"` / `"watchlist"` / `"all"` |
| `watchlistCoinIds` | string | `"bitcoin,ethereum,solana"` | Comma-separated CoinGecko coin IDs |
| `topCoinsLimit` | number | `20` | Số coins top market cap |

| `volumeChangeThreshold` | number | `50` | % volume spike để trigger |
| `currency` | string | `"usd"` | Đơn vị tiền tệ |

### CoinGecko API Endpoints (Free tier, no API key needed)

| Endpoint | Dùng cho | Khi nào gọi |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `GET /api/v3/coins/markets?vs_currency=usd&order=market_cap_desc&per_page={limit}` | Top coins: giá, volume, market cap, % change | scanMode = `"top"` hoặc `"all"` |
| `GET /api/v3/search/trending` | Trending coins đang hot | scanMode = `"trending"` hoặc `"all"` |
| `GET /api/v3/simple/price?ids={coinIds}&vs_currencies={currency}&include_24hr_change=true&include_24hr_vol=true` | Watchlist cụ thể | scanMode = `"watchlist"` hoặc `"all"` |

**Rate limit**: Free tier cho phép 10-30 calls/phút. Với scan mỗi 5 phút, mỗi lần gọi tối đa 3 endpoints (mode `"all"`), nằm trong giới hạn an toàn.

### Data Flow

```
┌──────────────┐     ┌───────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐
│ CoinGecko    │     │ Plugin State  │     │ Events           │
│ Free API     │────▶│ (lưu kết quả │────▶│ "coingecko-scan- │
│              │     │  scan + diff  │     │  complete"        │
│ /coins/      │     │  với lần      │     │                  │
│  markets     │     │  trước)       │     │ "coingecko-      │
│ /search/     │     │               │     │  price-alert"    │
│  trending    │     └───────────────┘     └────────┬─────────┘
└──────────────┘                                    │
                                                    ▼
                                           ┌──────────────────┐
                                           │ Nếu threshold    │
                                           │ vượt ngưỡng:     │
                                           │ • Tạo Issue      │
                                           │ • Emit alert     │
                                           │   event          │
                                           └──────────────────┘
```

### Worker Logic

```
Job "scan-coingecko" chạy mỗi lần:

1. Đọc config (companyId, scanMode, thresholds, coin list)
2. Gọi CoinGecko API theo scanMode:
   - "top"       → GET /coins/markets
   - "trending"  → GET /search/trending
   - "watchlist" → GET /simple/price
   - "all"       → gọi cả 3
3. Đọc state cũ: ctx.state.get({ scopeKind: "instance", stateKey: "last-scan" })
4. So sánh với lần scan trước:
   - Tính % thay đổi giá mỗi coin
   - Tính % thay đổi volume mỗi coin
5. Lưu state mới: ctx.state.set({ scopeKind: "instance", stateKey: "last-scan" }, newData)
6. Emit event "coingecko-scan-complete" (luôn luôn, chứa toàn bộ data)
7. Check thresholds cho từng coin:
   - Nếu |priceChange| > priceChangeThreshold HOẶC |volumeChange| > volumeChangeThreshold:
     → Emit "coingecko-price-alert" (chứa coin + lý do)
     → Tạo issue trong company:
       Title: "🔔 {COIN} {+/-X%} trong 24h"
       Description: Chi tiết price, volume, so sánh
       Priority: "high" nếu >20%, "medium" nếu >10%
8. Ghi activity log: "Scanned {N} coins, {M} alerts triggered"
```

### Plugin State Schema

```typescript
// stateKey: "last-scan"
{
  scannedAt: string;          // ISO timestamp
  scanMode: string;
  coins: Array<{
    id: string;               // "bitcoin"
    symbol: string;           // "btc"
    name: string;             // "Bitcoin"
    currentPrice: number;
    priceChange24h: number;   // % change
    volume24h: number;
    volumeChange24h: number;  // % change (so với lần scan trước)
    marketCap: number;
    source: "top" | "trending" | "watchlist";
  }>;
  alertsTriggered: number;
}
```

### Events Emitted

| Event | Khi nào | Payload |
|-------|--------|---------|
| `coingecko-scan-complete` | Mỗi lần scan xong | `{ scannedAt, coinCount, coins: [...] }` |
| `coingecko-price-alert` | Coin vượt threshold | `{ coin, priceChange, volumeChange, reason }` |

### Error Handling

| Lỗi | Xử lý |
|------|--------|
| CoinGecko 429 (rate limit) | Log warning, skip lần này, chờ lần sau |
| API timeout / network error | Log error, không crash worker |
| Config thiếu companyId | Skip tạo issue + skip emit events (cả 2 cần companyId), vẫn scan và lưu state |
| Lần scan đầu (không có state cũ) | Lưu data, không so sánh, không trigger alerts |

---

## Part 2: Skill `market-analysis`

### Tổng quan

Skill markdown (~50 dòng) dạy agent (Market Analyst) cách phân tích crypto market data bằng price action đơn giản. Agent đọc skill này lúc startup và follow quy trình khi checkout task phân tích.

### Cấu trúc file

```
skills/market-analysis/
└── SKILL.md
```

### Nội dung SKILL.md

**Frontmatter:**
```yaml
name: market-analysis
description: Hướng dẫn agent phân tích thị trường crypto bằng price action — so sánh % thay đổi giá, volume, trend tuần
```

**Các phần chính:**

#### 1. Khi nào dùng skill này
- Khi checkout task liên quan phân tích market/crypto
- Khi đọc data từ coingecko-scanner hoặc polymarket-scanner

#### 2. Quy trình phân tích (5 bước)

```
Bước 1: Thu thập data
  → Đọc task comments/documents chứa scan results
  → Đọc memory (para-memory) để lấy data tuần trước nếu có

Bước 2: So sánh % thay đổi
  → Giá 24h: tăng/giảm bao nhiêu %?
  → Volume 24h: spike hay giảm so với trung bình?
  → So với tuần trước: trend đi lên hay xuống?

Bước 3: Xác định tín hiệu
  → 🟢 Bullish: giá tăng >5% + volume tăng >20%
  → 🔴 Bearish: giá giảm >5% + volume tăng (panic sell)
  → 🟡 Neutral: biến động <5%, volume bình thường

Bước 4: Tổng hợp
  → Xếp hạng coins theo mức độ đáng chú ý
  → Highlight top 3 movers

Bước 5: Output
  → Comment lên task theo template bên dưới
  → Nếu có signal 🟢 hoặc 🔴 mạnh → tạo subtask cho Content Writer
  → Lưu vào para-memory để tuần sau so sánh
```

#### 3. Tiêu chí đánh giá

| Signal | Điều kiện | Hành động |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| 🟢 Bullish mạnh | Giá +>10%, volume +>30% | Tạo subtask viết bài |
| 🟢 Bullish nhẹ | Giá +5-10% | Ghi nhận, theo dõi |
| 🟡 Neutral | Biến động <5% | Ghi nhận |
| 🔴 Bearish nhẹ | Giá -5-10% | Ghi nhận, theo dõi |
| 🔴 Bearish mạnh | Giá ->10%, volume +>30% | Tạo subtask viết bài cảnh báo |

#### 4. Template Output

```markdown
## Market Analysis - [Ngày]

### Top Movers (24h)
| Coin | Giá | 24h % | Volume % | Signal |
|------|-----|-------|----------|--------|
| ...  | ... | ...   | ...      | 🟢/🔴/🟡 |

### Tín hiệu đáng chú ý
- [Coin]: [Lý do] — [Hành động đề xuất]

### So với tuần trước
- Trend chung: [Bullish/Bearish/Sideways]
- Điểm khác biệt: [...]

### Đề xuất
- [ ] Viết bài về [topic] (nếu có signal mạnh)
```

### Mối liên hệ Plugin ↔ Skill

```
Plugin coingecko-scanner          Skill market-analysis
┌─────────────────────┐          ┌─────────────────────┐
│ Scan data tự động   │          │ Dạy agent cách      │
│ Lưu vào state       │────▶     │ đọc data từ plugin  │
│ Emit events         │          │ So sánh % change     │
│ Tạo issue nếu alert │          │ Phân loại tín hiệu  │
│                     │          │ Output theo template │
└─────────────────────┘          └─────────────────────┘
     (code tự chạy)                 (kiến thức cho AI)
```

Plugin cung cấp **data thô + alerts tự động**. Skill dạy agent **cách phân tích sâu hơn và viết báo cáo** khi được giao task.

## Review Report: CoinGecko Scanner Plugin Implementation Plan

### Verification Item 1: package.json dependency pattern

**Status: PASS**

The plan specifies `"@paperclipai/plugin-sdk": "^2026.325.0"` on line 77 of the plan. This matches the pattern used by all three reference plugins:

- `plugin-polymarket-scanner/package.json` line 25: `"^2026.325.0"`
- `plugin-telegram-notifier/package.json` line 25: `"^2026.325.0"`
- `plugin-x-scanner/package.json` line 25: `"^2026.325.0"`

The fix from `"workspace:*"` to `"^2026.325.0"` is correct and consistent.

**Minor note:** The plan's package.json omits `"test": "vitest run"` in scripts and `"vitest": "^3.0.0"` in devDependencies, both of which are present in all three reference plugins. This is acceptable for an MVP with no tests defined, but worth noting for future alignment.

### Verification Item 2: Worker companyId handling

**Status: PASS**

The spec at `/Users/vuongluu/Documents/jobs/lab3/paperclip/paperclip/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-03-27-coingecko-scanner-market-analysis-design.md` (line 189) states:

> Config thieu companyId: Skip tao issue + skip emit events (ca 2 can companyId), van scan va luu state

The worker implementation in the plan (lines 498-503, 590, 661-685) does exactly this:

1. Line 499: `const hasCompanyId = !!config?.companyId;`
2. Line 500-503: Logs a warning but does not return early -- continues scanning.
3. Line 590: Alert processing is gated by `if (hasCompanyId && prevScan !== null)` -- skips events and issues when no companyId.
4. Line 655-658: State is always saved regardless of companyId.
5. Line 662: Event emission and activity logging are gated by `if (hasCompanyId)`.

This correctly matches the spec's error handling table.

### Verification Item 3: State save ordering (crash safety)

**Status: ISSUE FOUND -- but acceptable given the trade-off**

The plan's comment on line 581 says "Save state FIRST (crash-safe: even if alerts fail, data is persisted)." However, looking at the actual execution order:

- Line 582-587: `scanResult` object is **created** with `alertsTriggered: 0`.
- Lines 590-652: Alerts are processed, incrementing the local `alertsTriggered` counter.
- Line 655: `scanResult.alertsTriggered` is updated with the final count.
- Line 656-659: State is actually **saved** here, AFTER alert processing.

The state save happens at line 656, which is AFTER the alert loop (lines 590-652), not before it. This means if the worker crashes mid-alert-processing, the scan data is lost and must be re-fetched next cycle.

**However**, I consider this acceptable for the following reason: saving before alerts with `alertsTriggered: 0` and then saving again after with the real count would require two state writes per cycle. The current single-write approach is simpler. If a crash occurs during alert processing, the next 5-minute cycle will simply re-scan -- the data is ephemeral market data anyway, so no permanent loss occurs.

If true crash resilience were desired, the state save should be moved to before line 590 (before the alert loop), with the `alertsTriggered` field updated in a second save after. But for an MVP this is fine.

### Verification Item 4: Spec alignment -- file structure

**Status: PASS**

The spec's file structure (lines 17-26) shows `ui/index.tsx` (not `settings-page.tsx`) and no `vite.config.ts`. The plan matches this exactly:

- Plan line 29: `src/ui/index.tsx`
- No vite.config.ts anywhere in the plan.

### Additional observations

1. The spec's worker logic (lines 130-152) shows step 5 (save state) BEFORE step 6 (emit scan-complete) and step 7 (check thresholds/alerts). The plan reorders this so that state is saved after alerts. This is a minor deviation from the spec's described order, but functionally equivalent since the state save still happens.

2. The spec says `coingecko-scan-complete` should be emitted "always" (line 143: "luon luon, chua toan bo data"), but the plan gates it behind `hasCompanyId` (line 662). This is correct because `ctx.events.emit` requires a `companyId` parameter -- without it, the event cannot be emitted. The spec's error handling table (line 189) confirms this: "skip emit events."

---

## Verdict: APPROVED

All three verification items pass. The fixes are correctly applied:

1. SDK dependency `"^2026.325.0"` matches the established pattern across all example plugins.
2. Worker companyId handling matches the spec's error handling: scan + save state, skip events/issues.
3. State save ordering is not strictly "before alerts" as the comment claims, but the single-save approach is a reasonable MVP simplification with no data-loss risk given the 5-minute re-scan cycle.

No remaining critical or important issues.

# Subagent-Driven Development

Execute plan by dispatching fresh subagent per task, with two-stage review after each: spec compliance review first, then code quality review.

**Why subagents:** You delegate tasks to specialized agents with isolated context. By precisely crafting their instructions and context, you ensure they stay focused and succeed at their task. They should never inherit your session's context or history — you construct exactly what they need. This also preserves your own context for coordination work.

**Core principle:** Fresh subagent per task + two-stage review (spec then quality) = high quality, fast iteration

## When to Use

```dot
digraph when_to_use {
    "Have implementation plan?" [shape=diamond];
    "Tasks mostly independent?" [shape=diamond];
    "Stay in this session?" [shape=diamond];
    "subagent-driven-development" [shape=box];
    "executing-plans" [shape=box];
    "Manual execution or brainstorm first" [shape=box];

    "Have implementation plan?" -> "Tasks mostly independent?" [label="yes"];
    "Have implementation plan?" -> "Manual execution or brainstorm first" [label="no"];
    "Tasks mostly independent?" -> "Stay in this session?" [label="yes"];
    "Tasks mostly independent?" -> "Manual execution or brainstorm first" [label="no - tightly coupled"];
    "Stay in this session?" -> "subagent-driven-development" [label="yes"];
    "Stay in this session?" -> "executing-plans" [label="no - parallel session"];
}
```

**vs. Executing Plans (parallel session):**
- Same session (no context switch)
- Fresh subagent per task (no context pollution)
- Two-stage review after each task: spec compliance first, then code quality
- Faster iteration (no human-in-loop between tasks)

## The Process

```dot

    rankdir=TB;

    subgraph cluster_per_task {
        label="Per Task";
        "Dispatch implementer subagent (./implementer-prompt.md)" [shape=box];
        "Implementer subagent asks questions?" [shape=diamond];
        "Answer questions, provide context" [shape=box];
        "Implementer subagent implements, tests, commits, self-reviews" [shape=box];
        "Dispatch spec reviewer subagent (./spec-reviewer-prompt.md)" [shape=box];

        "Implementer subagent fixes spec gaps" [shape=box];
        "Dispatch code quality reviewer subagent (./code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md)" [shape=box];
        "Code quality reviewer subagent approves?" [shape=diamond];
        "Implementer subagent fixes quality issues" [shape=box];
        "Mark task complete in TodoWrite" [shape=box];
    }

    "Read plan, extract all tasks with full text, note context, create TodoWrite" [shape=box];
    "More tasks remain?" [shape=diamond];
    "Dispatch final code reviewer subagent for entire implementation" [shape=box];
    "Use superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch" [shape=box style=filled fillcolor=lightgreen];

    "Read plan, extract all tasks with full text, note context, create TodoWrite" -> "Dispatch implementer subagent (./implementer-prompt.md)";

    "Dispatch spec reviewer subagent (./spec-reviewer-prompt.md)" -> "Spec reviewer subagent confirms code matches spec?";
    "Spec reviewer subagent confirms code matches spec?" -> "Implementer subagent fixes spec gaps" [label="no"];
    "Implementer subagent fixes spec gaps" -> "Dispatch spec reviewer subagent (./spec-reviewer-prompt.md)" [label="re-review"];
    "Spec reviewer subagent confirms code matches spec?" -> "Dispatch code quality reviewer subagent (./code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md)" [label="yes"];

    "Code quality reviewer subagent approves?" -> "Implementer subagent fixes quality issues" [label="no"];

    "More tasks remain?" -> "Dispatch final code reviewer subagent for entire implementation" [label="no"];
    "Dispatch final code reviewer subagent for entire implementation" -> "Use superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch";
}
```

## Model Selection

Use the least powerful model that can handle each role to conserve cost and increase speed.

**Mechanical implementation tasks** (isolated functions, clear specs, 1-2 files): use a fast, cheap model. Most implementation tasks are mechanical when the plan is well-specified.

**Integration and judgment tasks** (multi-file coordination, pattern matching, debugging): use a standard model.

**Architecture, design, and review tasks**: use the most capable available model.

**Task complexity signals:**
- Touches 1-2 files with a complete spec → cheap model
- Touches multiple files with integration concerns → standard model
- Requires design judgment or broad codebase understanding → most capable model

## Handling Implementer Status

Implementer subagents report one of four statuses. Handle each appropriately:

**DONE:** Proceed to spec compliance review.

**DONE_WITH_CONCERNS:** The implementer completed the work but flagged doubts. Read the concerns before proceeding. If the concerns are about correctness or scope, address them before review. If they're observations (e.g., "this file is getting large"), note them and proceed to review.

**NEEDS_CONTEXT:** The implementer needs information that wasn't provided. Provide the missing context and re-dispatch.

**BLOCKED:** The implementer cannot complete the task. Assess the blocker:
1. If it's a context problem, provide more context and re-dispatch with the same model
2. If the task requires more reasoning, re-dispatch with a more capable model
3. If the task is too large, break it into smaller pieces
4. If the plan itself is wrong, escalate to the human

**Never** ignore an escalation or force the same model to retry without changes. If the implementer said it's stuck, something needs to change.

## Prompt Templates

- `./implementer-prompt.md` - Dispatch implementer subagent
- `./spec-reviewer-prompt.md` - Dispatch spec compliance reviewer subagent
- `./code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md` - Dispatch code quality reviewer subagent

## Example Workflow

  - Committed

  - 8/8 tests passing

  - Missing: Progress reporting (spec says "report every 100 items")
  - Extra: Added --json flag (not requested)

[Spec reviewer reviews again]

[Dispatch code quality reviewer]

...

[After all tasks]
[Dispatch final code-reviewer]

Done!
```

## Advantages

**vs. Manual execution:**
- Subagents follow TDD naturally
- Fresh context per task (no confusion)
- Parallel-safe (subagents don't interfere)
- Subagent can ask questions (before AND during work)

**vs. Executing Plans:**
- Same session (no handoff)
- Continuous progress (no waiting)
- Review checkpoints automatic

**Efficiency gains:**
- No file reading overhead (controller provides full text)
- Controller curates exactly what context is needed
- Subagent gets complete information upfront
- Questions surfaced before work begins (not after)

**Quality gates:**
- Self-review catches issues before handoff
- Two-stage review: spec compliance, then code quality
- Review loops ensure fixes actually work
- Spec compliance prevents over/under-building
- Code quality ensures implementation is well-built

**Cost:**
- More subagent invocations (implementer + 2 reviewers per task)
- Controller does more prep work (extracting all tasks upfront)
- Review loops add iterations

- Start implementation on main/master branch without explicit user consent
- Skip reviews (spec compliance OR code quality)
- Proceed with unfixed issues
- Dispatch multiple implementation subagents in parallel (conflicts)
- Make subagent read plan file (provide full text instead)
- Skip scene-setting context (subagent needs to understand where task fits)
- Ignore subagent questions (answer before letting them proceed)
- Accept "close enough" on spec compliance (spec reviewer found issues = not done)
- Skip review loops (reviewer found issues = implementer fixes = review again)
- Let implementer self-review replace actual review (both are needed)

- Move to next task while either review has open issues

**If subagent asks questions:**
- Answer clearly and completely
- Provide additional context if needed
- Don't rush them into implementation

**If reviewer finds issues:**
- Implementer (same subagent) fixes them
- Reviewer reviews again
- Repeat until approved
- Don't skip the re-review
